title: Regrets et conditionnel 3
goal: Analyser une erreur passée et ce qu'il aurait fallu faire.
points: Conditionnel 3 : « if + past perfect », puis « would have + participe » : « If we had shipped earlier, we would have avoided the storm. »
« I wish » ou « If only » + past perfect expriment un regret : « If only we had checked the documents. »
« should have / shouldn't have + participe » = ce qu'il aurait fallu faire : « We should have booked the vessel sooner. »
Conditionnel mixte (passé → présent) : « If we had signed the contract, we would be in Lagos now. »
examples: If we had checked the seal, we would have noticed the damage.
Si nous avions vérifié le scellé, nous aurions remarqué les dégâts.
I wish we had insured the cargo.
Si seulement nous avions assuré la marchandise.
We should have booked the vessel two weeks earlier.
Nous aurions dû réserver le navire deux semaines plus tôt.
If Kodjo had sent the invoice, the goods would be cleared now.
Si Kodjo avait envoyé la facture, la marchandise serait dédouanée maintenant.

exercises.prompt: Quelle phrase exprime correctement une hypothèse sur le passé ?
options: If we would have known, we would have acted.
If we had known, we would have acted.
If we knew, we would have acted.
If we had known, we will act.
exercises.explain: Conditionnel 3 : « if + past perfect » puis « would have + participe passé ». On ne met jamais « would » après « if ».

exercises.sentence: If the driver ___ the wrong road, he would have arrived on time.
options: hadn't taken
didn't take
wouldn't take
hasn't taken
exercises.explain: Dans la partie « if » du conditionnel 3, on utilise le past perfect : « hadn't taken ».

exercises.audio: We should have checked the documents before loading.
options: We should have checked the documents before loading.
We should check the documents before loading.
We shouldn't have checked the documents before loading.
We should have checked the documents after loading.
exercises.explain: « should have checked » = nous aurions dû vérifier : un regret sur une action passée.

exercises.fr: Si seulement nous avions assuré la marchandise.
exercises.answer: If only we had insured the goods
exercises.explain: « If only + past perfect » exprime un regret sur le passé.

exercises.sentence: If we had signed the contract last month, we ___ in Lagos now.
options: would be
would have been
will be
had been
exercises.explain: Conditionnel mixte : condition passée (« had signed »), conséquence présente (« would be … now »).

exercises.prompt: Un client te reproche un retard. Quelle réponse reconnaît l'erreur avec tact ?
options: With hindsight, we should have warned you earlier.
You should have warned us earlier.
We would warn you earlier.
With hindsight, we must warn you earlier.
exercises.explain: « With hindsight, we should have… » reconnaît poliment une erreur passée.

exercises.answer: We would have avoided the demurrage
exercises.explain: Conséquence imaginaire dans le passé : « would have + participe passé ».

exercises.audio: If they had told us, we wouldn't have paid.
options: If they had told us, we wouldn't have paid.
If they told us, we wouldn't pay.
If they had told us, we would have paid.
If they'd told us, we won't pay.
exercises.explain: « If they had told us » + « wouldn't have paid » : nous n'aurions pas payé.

exercises.text: With hindsight, we should have booked the vessel earlier.
exercises.fr: Avec le recul, nous aurions dû réserver le navire plus tôt.

author: claude
